title: Taylor Swift's Wedding Dress to Channel Classic Hollywood Icon Elizabeth Taylor After Music Video Obsession - NewsBreak
text:
By Manhaz Muntaha ,
7 hours ago Taylor Swift is a popular singer who is currently quite known in the NFL community. She has been dating Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce and is engaged to him.
The two of them are currently planning to get married, though the details are still being kept secret. Despite keeping most of the details secret, there is one specific thing that has been revealed.
Taylor Swift’s wedding dress inspiration revealed Swift’s upcoming wedding dress is reportedly drawing direct inspiration from a classic Hollywood bridal gown worn by Elizabeth Taylor in 1950. She was a popular actress in the 1950s, during the classical era of Hollywood. Swift has been fascinated with the actress from long ago. She has referenced Elizabeth multiple times in her career.
Feb 15, 2016; Los Angeles, CA, USA; Taylor Swift performs during the 58th Grammy Awards at the Staples Center. Mandatory Credit: Robert Hanashiro-USA TODAY NETWORK via Imagn Images According to sources close to the singer, Swift had become deeply interested in the life and image of the late screen legend while researching and creating the music video for her song “Elizabeth Taylor”. The song was the second track on her 2025 album The Life of a Showgirl, and does not feature the singer herself, but rather made up of archival clips from the actress’s films.
Elizabeth got married on May 6, 1950 to hotel heir Conrad Hilton at the age of 18. She wore a wedding gown, the design of which was a traditional white satin design with a fitted bodice, modest neckline, and full skirt typical of mid-century bridal fashion. Though the marriage only lasted eight months, the image of Elizabeth in the dress became one of her early iconic images.
ALSO READ: Blake Lively Accused of Putting Travis Kelce’s Fiancee Taylor Swift’s Cookie Recipe in Legal Documents
However, the exact details of Swift’s final wedding gown is undisclosed, and there is no confirmation whether hers would be inspired by Elizabeth’s. More details regarding the wedding have been revealed.
Taylor Swift’s bridesmaids plan wedding surprise Swift’s bridesmaids at the wedding consist of some A-list celebrities, such as close friends Gigi Hadid and Selena Gomez. According to a Page Six report, the group is assembling a six- to seven-minute video montage featuring footage of Swift smiling and laughing throughout her relationship with Kelce.
The video will start from the couple’s journey from their first meeting in summer 2023 through their engagement in August 2025 and up to the upcoming nuptials. Gomez is also organizing a karaoke session for the guests, which will allow friends to sing praises and celebrate Swift’s career.
Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce are set to get married, with further details yet to be confirmed.
